definitions.ask: Where should the time pill sit on a ledger Task Link row?
definitions.why: Mirrors the Events row (time, name, off chip) and gcal sync's time-ordered MEET links

choices.label: Leads the link like the Events row, so MEET links read as a column of times
Trails the link, like bob's "Swings! (0800-0815)" copy; 🔓/🔑/off must skip it
